q: Which Barcelona striker bit an opponent at the 2014 World Cup, months before the club signed him?
sub: He bit Giorgio Chiellini, and served the ban before his debut.

q: Real Madrid's galactico era began in 2000 with a signing taken from Barcelona. Who was he?
What was thrown at Luis Figo from the Camp Nou crowd when he returned there with Real Madrid?
Which Real Madrid defender headed a stoppage-time equaliser in the 2014 Champions League final?
sub: La Decima, in the ninety-third minute.

q: Barcelona overturned a 4-0 deficit against Paris Saint-Germain in 2017. What is that night called?
sub: 6-1, with three goals in the last seven minutes.

q: Which club won La Liga in 1999-2000, the only league title in its history?
Which club broke Madrid and Barcelona's hold on La Liga in 2013-14 under Diego Simeone?
sub: Sealed with a draw at the Camp Nou on the final day.

q: Which goalkeeper captained Real Madrid for a decade and lifted the World Cup for Spain in 2010?
Lionel Messi left Barcelona in 2021 because the club could not register his contract. Which club did he join?
Which club did Rafael Benitez manage to two La Liga titles before he joined Liverpool?
Which Barcelona defender captained the side through the Guardiola years and retired in 2014?
Which Spanish club is owned by its members rather than a proprietor, who elect its president?
sub: Real Madrid, Athletic Bilbao and Osasuna are member-owned too.
